title: Gate at a position in the unrolled circuit
statement: Let a sequential circuit be unrolled for $T$ steps, and let $p$ be an index smaller than the number of gates in the resulting DAG circuit. The gate at position $p$ is the gate specified by the unrolling rule at position $p$.
hypotheses_covered: The index $p$ is less than the number of gates in the unrolled circuit
